verdict.rationale: The evidence shows jo has its own isolated cloud machine, can build and publish websites, and can generate decks from outlines. None of it documents jo writing and running code on user data to produce charts, computed answers, or downloadable analysis files. Deck and website generation are adjacent features, and having a dedicated machine is infrastructure, not a documented code-execution or analysis capability.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can have the assistant write and run code on my data to produce charts, computed answers, and downloadable files
